## What's New

- **RuntimeChip & TaskRuntimePanel** — new components for runtime status display
- **Network Proxy** — configurable proxy support (`internal/netproxy`)
- **Sensitive Data Masking** — `internal/mask` package for safe logging
- **Enhanced Diagnostics** — improved diagnostics panel and shell UI
- **Task State** — better task state management and bridge runtime snapshot
- **Settings & Login** — extended settings store, login env, and report capabilities

## Removed

- **OfficeCLI Core Update** — removed from settings (runtime update UI)
- **Bridge Binary Path** — removed from settings and onboarding

## Infrastructure

- Additional Go test coverage (preview HTML, runtime snapshot, provider)
- i18n updates (en/zh)

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/officecli/officedex/compare/v0.2.2...v0.3.0
